rows.grounds: locative plural of beings from dog onward

items.question: Why is Maheśvara called Maheśvara?
premises: Maheśvara resembles beings from dog onward.
items.inference: Maheśvara is named from resemblance and delight.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation to prior verses is unclear.
The gloss of ramyatva as delight is approximate.
items.plain_english: Maheśvara is so called because of his similarity to beings from the dog onward and because of delight.
